topic: Myth: you can mine Bitcoin profitably with a gaming GPU
hook: Can your gaming PC mine Bitcoin? Not in any practical way.

scenes.narration: Many beginners think a gaming graphics card can mine Bitcoin.
Specialised chips called ASICs are far more efficient at SHA-256 than graphics cards or CPUs.
Mining Bitcoin with a GPU is not practical today, because ASICs are so much more efficient at the same job.

cta: Want to dig deeper? There's a link on my channel page if you'd like to explore digital mining.
title: Can a Gaming GPU Mine Bitcoin? (The Honest Answer)
description_body: ASICs dominate SHA-256 mining, which is why GPU mining Bitcoin is not practical today.
